record.title: Omniscient Reader
record.description:
Dokja was an average office worker whose sole interest was reading his favorite web novel "Three Ways to Survive the Apocalypse." But when the novel suddenly becomes reality, he is the only person who knows how the world will end. Armed with this realization, Dokja uses his understanding to change the course of the story, and the world, as he knows it.

record.title: Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint (Novel)
record.description:
**IF YOU ARE READING THIS, YOU WILL SURVIVE.**

Kill each other within the time limit or die. It’s just another evening commute on the train, until the passengers are given an order they can’t disobey. Utter chaos ensues, but ordinary office worker Dokja Kim only feels an unsettling calm. He knows exactly how this will play out! The subway car, the passengers’ reactions, even the bizarre creature that suddenly appears to oversee this sadistic scenario…everything is straight out of his favorite story, an online novel so obscure he is its sole reader. And as the only one who knows where the plot is headed, Dokja must use his knowledge to survive the oncoming apocalypse!

*Source: Yen Press, Vol. 1*

**Original Webnovel:**  
[Munpia](https://novel.munpia.com/104753), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/novel/detail.nhn?productNo=3400123)

[Official English](https://yenpress.com/titles/9798400903526-omniscient-reader-s-viewpoint-novel-vol-1)

Thankfully, she's locked down a gig as a bodyguard for Ashan, a prince next in line for the sultan's throne in Oman. record.title: Avengers Social Club
record.description:
Features three women from different walks of life coming together for revenge: a fish store ajumma who envisioned a better life for herself, a housewife who grew up an orphan, and a chaebol magnate's daughter who was raised like a delicate flower. They're an unlikely trio who would never otherwise meet, but they join forces to carry out their individual revenges. Although they start out as co-conspirators, along the way they become close to one another.  
(Source: The live-action ver. synopsis on Wikipedia)

record.title: Ane Comi
record.description: The one thing not ordinary about high school student Ryouta is that he has an aspiring manga artist for an older sister. She is so dedicated to her drawing that, despite being 21, she's never really been in a romantic situation. Unfortunately, when she gets her first real job, it's to write an erotic manga. Desperately, she enlists the reluctant Ryouta's help, as a 'model,' to figure out how exactly to draw this sort of manga.

record.title: Doka Kimi ni Abakaretai
record.description:
Hayama is a skittish and struggling young artist specializing in bijin-ga, a genre focused on painting beautiful women. After fleeing from yet another model, he finds a beautiful figure collapsed by the roadside and takes them in —only to discover that they’re actually a boy in women’s clothes! But this time, Kenzan doesn’t feel the urge to run. Instead, he may have just found the perfect subject for his work!

(Source: Yen Press)

record.description:

And as fate would have it, she comes across the perfect opportunity when she catches the eye of the young emperor desperate to birth an heir to his throne. Now one of his royal concubines, Bokja must compete with the other women after the king's heart to ensure both her and her family's continued survival.

record.title: Sikeum Saekeum
record.description:
"It's a blessing that there is a person who listens to my story."  
Not an ordinary, but an ordinary romance comic.

This webtoon focuses on Suwan, an ordinary high school girl that just cut ties with her two best friends. While feeling sad and alone under her frequent spot, the Tunnel of Tears, she befriends a blonde costumed gentleman (in a bunny suit) who listens to her troubles and comforts her. She also makes friends with a gal named Miel and her group, while continually doing what she can to comfort and help her friends just the same. 

[Original Webtoon](http://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list.nhn?titleId=509092)
